spec.title: Grid Power (KPLC)
spec.description:
Real power at the grid connection, register 25214.

Negative = importing from KPLC, positive = exporting. Verified against a bypass reading of -473 W while the load drew 474 W.

This is real power (W). The KPLC panel above shows volts and amps, whose product is apparent power (VA) and will read higher whenever the power factor is below 1.
